My friend and I could also compare our ideas during the activity, which would make it easier to stay involved. Learning about this topic is worthwhile because people can avoid wasting treated water.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thói quen tiết kiệm nước cần đi cùng cách báo và sửa rò rỉ rõ trách nhiệm.

paragraphs.label: So sánh hai phương án còn lại
paragraphs.text: I would not choose the guide this time. It could be useful for later revision, but it would not give us immediate feedback when we have questions. Short videos would be convenient too, but watching them separately would not meet our wish to practise together with someone who can help.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không nói hai cách kia vô ích; chỉ ra vì sao ít phù hợp trong tình huống này.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết luận
paragraphs.text: Of course, I would still check that the information is suitable for a beginner. One point I would want to understand is that simple advice may overlook problems beyond a resident's control. After learning the basics, I could try one small idea and see whether it helps. For these reasons, my first choice would be the most practical starting point.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn, quay về lựa chọn đã nêu.
